## Design

### 2026-10-25 – In the first hour I started to build the base with a 320 × 120 × 18 mm shell floor and perimeter, with a centred rear USB-C opening, full key-window bezel, and bored three-button rear deck. This group

**11h**

In the first hour I started to build the base with a 320 × 120 × 18 mm shell floor and perimeter, with a centred rear USB-C opening, full key-window bezel, and bored three-button rear deck. This groups the related enclosure geometry that was previously split across several tiny steps.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/8efb953917149bec85bb41edd58c25c85e0a0d06aa163be8abc614056565ed01.png)

By the second hour the enclosure shell has a full two-octave key set: 15 white keys and 10 black keys, mapped in pitch order from MIDI 48 (C3) through MIDI 72 (C5).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/7b8e1bff5755b938fe50f5a9ac148d834dd7d1bd3bd45c99643ecdf919de99dd.png)

By hour 4: Each note has a pivot seat and pin, and the A and B followers represent sequential electrical contacts: the first contact should trigger before the second as the key travels down.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/bf9af34ebe86fc349333be36ff4c6f02a73bd78faa9be8bb9812e79e67744cc2.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/82ab06c5e908f8f4910ba6ae0da66462067067d7b0ad96fad880b2ee6a116f55.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/90967660d03344d9859fe8ecbee16f3128829c385b769c15a0dd9df3412f654d.png)

By Hour 6.5: All the physical switches were placed. Also 3 buttons and the USB-C port was added.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/2ddcf3e2c65f4c0bb15b02e69304685781ebd43cbfbf775b2696e53f729ff0b3.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/4cc36766155cbf58703477a565b7803ca680ee211019d53a9dc1f477c5dbe53f.png)

By hour 7: I added some support

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/be8ae74e3c25007da9d6d8d0e2a61184c429eb21c85f04738b785b3563045816.png)

By hour 8.5, the schematic was finished:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/4c0281752d0abb9adc1d264031919792bcf71a4813509ce9710d893eeb53d681.png)

By hour 10, I made the Black Keys and white Keys keycaps' STL's:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/d543aab9122d158de7003f55a7bb38a79973d28cf0469bdc5a85bc6416539c19.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fpT4vKaaCxCaCu9yi3OynxGXkAPlXNzI/4382e5f8c6fb2e560d190c65347aaa7ebbb813757e308494dd47e767bb9f5985.png)

By hour 11, I finished the remaining small details, like the README and the final BOM file (which will be in the GitHub repo).
